svg.aria-label: A customer support agent's refund ticket as its evals see it, resolved with every check green. The same ticket through an iFixAi audit shows the agent hid a fraud flag, paid a refund a manager had declined and changed a customer's payout account without authorisation, while closing the ticket was handled correctly. Illustrative scenario.
